response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim > 0.439 GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') ORDER BY matched_records DESC;

assumptions.assumption: 'Number of matched records' counts advanced behaviour records (one per joined row), not distinct transaction records. Because translink is not unique, one transaction record can be matched by several advanced behaviour records.
Records with a NULL patsim are excluded, since NULL > 0.439 is not true. Inner join drops advanced behaviour records with no matching transaction record.
A missing ordertypedist is displayed as the label 'Missing'. This label does not collide with any enum value (Market, Mixed, Limit).

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct matched transaction records per order type mix, rather than advanced behaviour records.
alternatives.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS order_type_mix, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim > 0.439 GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') ORDER BY matched_records DESC;
